items.title: Notify Familienkasse if Marlene stops or interrupts her studies
items.quote: Bitte teilen Sie uns mit, wenn Marlene das Studium abbricht oder unterbricht.
items.computation: This is an ongoing, event-triggered obligation (notify if/when the study is abandoned or interrupted) with no calendar date or period attached in the letter, so no single due date can be computed; it must be reported promptly whenever such an event occurs.

items.title: Kindergeld payments begin
items.quote: für Ihre Tochter Marlene, geboren am 14.08.2006, setzen wir ab April 2025 Kindergeld in Höhe von 255,00 € monatlich fest (§§ 62, 63, 66 EStG).
items.computation: The decision fixes Kindergeld starting with the month of April 2025, i.e. from 1 April 2025 onward (monthly payments of €255.00).

items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch against the Kindergeld determination
items.quote: Wer mit dieser Festsetzung nicht einverstanden ist, kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch bei der Familienkasse Musterrhein erheben – schriftlich, elektronisch über ELSTER oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter dated and presumably posted 27.03.2025 (Thursday), after 1 Jan 2025, so the 4-day delivery fiction applies (§122 Abs.2 Nr.1 AO, applied to Familienkasse Kindergeld decisions). Counting calendar days from the posting day (not counted): 28.03 (Fri)=day1, 29.03 (Sat)=day2, 30.03 (Sun)=day3, 31.03 (Mon)=day4. Since the Familienkasse is treated like a tax authority, if the 4th day fell on a weekend/holiday it would move to the next working day under §108 Abs.3 AO, but 31.03.2025 is already a normal working Monday, so deemed delivery = 31.03.2025. The one-month Einspruch period (§355 Abs.1 AO) runs from 31.03.2025: one month later with the same day number is 30.04.2025 (April has no 31st day, so under §188 Abs.2/3 BGB it falls on the last day of April, 30.04.2025). 30.04.2025 is a Wednesday, not a weekend or NW public holiday, so no further shift applies under §108 Abs.3 AO.
